subject: Architecture
title: 3D-Printed Houses: Built in 24 Hours
description: A quick win: understand 3D-Printed Houses: Built in 24 Hours.

hook.text: A company in Texas printed a 2,000-square-foot house in under 48 hours — walls, plumbing channels, and all.

buildup.text: ICON's Vulcan printer extrudes concrete in layers — building walls from the ground up without formwork.

discovery.text: 3D-printed homes cost 30-50% less than conventional construction and produce far less waste material.

twist.text: The technology could solve housing crises — printing entire neighborhoods of affordable homes in weeks.

climax.text: The first permitted 3D-printed house in the U.S. sold for $475,000 in Austin — proof of mainstream acceptance.

punchline.text: A robot that prints houses. The construction worker of the future plugs in.

quiz.question: How much can 3D-printed homes reduce construction costs?
